body: On the back: “a greasy sheen in the cab after the greenhouse test. my wrists blistered. the tomato leaves went black within a day.”
title: cab note — before thursday lunch

body: I helped move the injured away from the barrier. Later an officer asked for the number of cars, not the number of people. He drew a fresh line under his total while two families were still behind the disabled van.
title: A count after gunfire
